Warm up: 200 Meter Jog / Empty Bar Snatch Warm up

1. Every 30 Seconds for 10 Sets:
1 Hang Full Snatch (light warm up weight, focus on full extension and speed under the bar)

2. Every 1:30 for 10 Sets:
1 Full Snatch (Increase weight as you go)

3. For Time:
50 Calorie Bike

Warm up: 1 Minute on Bike / 10 Air Squats / 10 Sit ups / 10 Ring Rows / 10 Push ups

For Time: (Break up however you like)
100 Walking Lunges
100 Kettlebell Swings
100 Mountain Climbers
100 Wallballs
100 Calorie Row

Warm up: 50Ft Bear Crawl / 10 Hand Release Push ups / 50Ft Broad Jumps / 10 Sit ups

1. For 5 Sets:
3 Push Press (increase weight as you go)
5 Kneeling Squat Jumps

2. As Many Rounds as Possible in 16 Minutes:
8 Pull ups
4 Burpee Box Jump Overs
2 Clean and Jerks
